children.name: Toxocara cati
children.description: Toxocara cati, also known as the feline roundworm, is a parasite of cats and other felids.

children.name: Toxocara vitulorum
children.description:
Toxocara vitulorum is a species of nematode belonging to the family Toxocaridae.
The species has cosmopolitan distribution.

children.name: Parascaris equorum
children.description: Parascaris equorum is a species of ascarid that is the equine roundworm.

Baylisascaris procyonis
children.description: Baylisascaris procyonis, also known by the common name raccoon roundworm, is a nematode, found ubiquitously in raccoons, the definitive hosts.

children.name: Baylisascaris schroederi
children.description: Baylisascaris schroederi is a species of roundworm in the family Ascarididae. It occurs in China and is a parasite of giant pandas. Many wild giant pandas are infected with this parasite and heavy infections can lead to the death of the animal.

children.description: Ascaris lumbricoides is a large parasitic roundworm of the genus Ascaris.

children.name: Ascaris suum Goeze, 1782
children.description: Ascaris suum, also known as the large roundworm of pig, is a parasitic nematode that causes ascariasis in pigs.
